waterfall-chart.title: Waterfall Chart
waterfall-chart.purpose: Coordinate step-based contribution charts with deltas, cumulative totals, selected-step review, and accessible data fallback without creating a second chart or table implementation.
useWhen: A workflow needs to explain positive, negative, neutral, and total contribution steps.
A template needs contribution analysis without owning chart internals.
The same chart data must be inspectable through a table/list fallback.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The analysis represents regulated, financial, legal, safety, or irreversible decisions.
The design requires custom chart rendering that Chart Wrapper cannot represent.
Increase, decrease, total, or selected-step semantics are color-only.
foundations: Accessibility
The labelled group and Chart Wrapper fallback keep step data inspectable without relying on visual bars alone.
Depth
Surface owns structural grouping while Chart Wrapper owns chart chrome and overlays.
Energy
Selected, loading, empty, error, and disabled states cascade into Chart Wrapper and Badge metrics.
Frame
Density, chart bounds, table fallback, and step list remain token-driven.
Growth
Contribution behavior becomes reusable for templates without moving chart or table logic into templates.
Iconography
Step and status symbols remain owned by Badge, Chart Wrapper, and child components.
Momentum
Loading and chart state transitions remain delegated to Chart Wrapper.
State
Pattern state maps to Chart Wrapper, Chart Panel, Table, List, and Badge boundaries.
Symbol
Increase, decrease, neutral, total, and selected semantics remain explicit through labels and fallback rows.
Tone
Neutral, selected, warning, danger, and disabled tones remain contract-bound.
Voice
Chart label, descriptions, step copy, and fallback rows stay explicit.
slots: Increase, decrease, total, variance, or risk metrics.
Chart state, Chart Panel ownership, status, actions, loading, empty, error, and table fallback.
Inspectable contribution rows delegated through Chart Wrapper table fallback.
Contribution feedback summary or recovery status.
variants: Steps provide label, value, direction, cumulative value, and note.
Total steps reset or expose cumulative summary.
Selected step cascades selected/focus state into Chart Wrapper and Table.
Metrics and feedback summarize risk without replacing chart semantics.
motion: Surface marks busy while Chart Wrapper owns loading rendering.
Chart Wrapper and Table own focus/selected state without local positioned bars.
Chart Wrapper preserves dimensions through chart, table, list, empty, and error states.
accessibility: Expose the contribution chart as a labelled group.
Provide step data through Chart Wrapper table fallback.
Represent increase, decrease, neutral, and total with labels, not only color.
Do not use color as the only way to communicate contribution direction or selected-step state.
implementationChecklist: Compose Surface, Badge, and Chart Wrapper.
Pass contribution values to Chart Wrapper instead of drawing local bars.
Pass step rows through Chart Wrapper table fallback.
Expose direction and cumulative values as text.
Reject Card wrappers, local chart renderers, raw tables, and docs-only shells.
tests: Composes Surface plus Chart Wrapper boundary.
Density and state cascade through Chart Wrapper and fallback rows.
Forwards step selection and primary action callbacks.
Step selection and primary actions preserve event context.
No local SVG/canvas/positioned chart, raw table, Card wrapper, or injected markup is emitted.

canDecide: Use Waterfall Chart for contribution and variance workflows.
Use Chart Wrapper for the visualization and fallback boundary.
Use Gantt Chart instead when duration and milestones are the primary object.
mustAsk: Before exposing regulated, financial, legal, safety, or irreversible analysis.
Before bypassing Chart Wrapper for custom visualization.
Before presenting direction or total semantics without textual explanation.
rejectIf: A local chart renderer replaces Chart Wrapper.
A Card wraps the contribution chart group.
miel.handoff: Confirm data source, step semantics, increase/decrease/total rules, selected-step behavior, accessible fallback, and empty/error behavior.
